card.name: "Every" or "each" before day or weeks
card.fires_on: The words "every" or "each" in dosing schedules, right before a time unit such as day or weeks. It is strongest after "at the same time" and after a dose amount.

modes.label: Same time each day
modes.description: "each" or "every" after "at the same time", just before "day".
modes.example: Take SOHONOS with food preferably at the same time<< each>> day

modes.label: Every N weeks
modes.description: "every" after a dose amount, just before a number of weeks.
modes.example: atic SCAC in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel 500 mg every 4 weeks or 375 mg<< every>> 3 weeks Until disease progression

card.writes: It promotes calendar-unit words like days, calendar and month, so it predicts a time unit comes next.
card.plain: It fires on "every" or "each" when a dosing schedule is about to name a day or week interval.
